entries.question: FR-001: the re-review route must incorporate the SIBLING lane (at its approval-stamp SHA) into the stale approved lane, because rollback restored the Mission branch. No CLI command does that today, and the #7285 A-10 rule (pinned by tests/lanes/test_stale_remediation_cli_command.py:76-96) forbids raw 'git merge' / 'cd .worktrees' recipes in the remedy.
